cases.question: Which datasets are consumed by processes that execute a machine learning model?
cases.sparql_preview:
PREFIX ml: <http://www.semanticweb.org/mnd14/ml/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?dataset
WHERE {
  ?process ml:executes ?model .
  ?process ml:hasDataInput ?dataset .
}
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Which datasets are consumed by processes that execute a machine learning model?
cases.sparql_preview:
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>
PREFIX ml: <http://www.semanticweb.org/mnd14/ml/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?dataset WHERE {
  ?mlProcess a/ml:executes|bfo:BFO_0000057 ?model .
  ?mlProcess ml:hasDataInput ?dataset .
  ?dataset a/rdfs:subClassOf* bfo:IAO_0000100 .
}
LIMIT 100
